recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Healing Without the Diagnosis Label", "body": "Pat describes The New Biology Clinic, launched by Dr. Tom Cowan with his son Asher running the vision, as a place that gives no medications, writes no prescriptions and diagnoses nobody. His reasoning is that words carry power, and he argues that people who hear a diagnosis often begin to embody it. He insists he cannot heal anyone, since only the client can do that, and he frames his role as facilitating people as they reconnect with themselves. The clinic offers unlimited visits with its general practitioner, monthly group workouts and webinars, and courses, with more modalities planned."}, {"title": "Stuck Energy on Every Level", "body": "Chance frames healing as a matter of layers. Stagnant energy, he says, can sit in the physical body, in the field around it and in the intangible mind, so when one approach stalls, another level can open the way. If someone feels stuck mentally, he suggests trying the physical; if the physical stalls, try the diet. Approaching life from all of those levels at once, Chance argues, makes it possible to live in a perpetual state of flow and synchronicity, and he holds that nobody has to stay stuck in pain, emotional turmoil or a feeling of lack."}, {"title": "The Three Tensions and Present Awareness", "body": "Pat explains the method behind P.A.T. Life, short for present awareness training. Breath comes first, because a person who is not breathing is not present. From there he teaches what he calls the three tensions: the intention of a movement, where attention is placed, and how much tension is actually being created against the ground. He describes clients shaking through a held lunge while staying calm, learning to tell pain from discomfort, and he argues that massage or manipulation without preparation can release stored tension before the body is ready to handle it."}, {"title": "The Body as a Living Text", "body": "The panel reads anatomy like scripture. Pat walks the foot as a calendar, from the hallux at the big toe through the ball and the arch to the heel, arguing that people who live on their heels have lost the springing forward of each step. The conversation finds the muse inside muscles, the spire inside inspiration and a link between posture and the poser. Chance adds an energetic dimension, describing the earth star and sun star points of the biofield and how their alignment with the spine tells a story of past and future."}, {"title": "Poison, Purity, and the Gift of Presence", "body": "Al shares his theory that small, regular exposures to poison can build a stronger immune system, and the panel weighs it against what they call the purity spiral of the truth community. Pat argues that anxious striving for perfect health can create the very stress it hopes to avoid, and that a joyful treat may serve someone better than a miserable diet. The conversation notes that gift means poison in German, and Pat closes on the idea that being present with a threat is itself a gift, sharpening intuition."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Patrick Daly of the P.A.T. Life podcast returns to discuss his new self-health venture, The New Biology Clinic. As a seasoned personal trainer and holistic mystic, Pat has learned to incorporate the wisdom of nature's sacred geometry and harmonic signatures into a powerful system of functional movement for helping the body not only heal, but become incredibly strong and resilient. Joining our panel is the eternal athlete and author, Al Dawg, along with Slick Dissident.
